Who's training, who's finished, who needs a nudge

Getting the latest progress…

It must have the People and Levels tabs that the training fills in.

How to read this. "Passed the test" means they finished the final challenge and got the certificate. "Needs a nudge" means they haven't finished and haven't trained for a while (or never started). "Rushing" means they moved much faster than it takes to read the steps. Treat it as a reason to chat, not a verdict.
